claims.text: The US Grant opened on October 15, 1910, after five years of construction in the heart of downtown San Diego.

findings.quote: The US Grant opened its doors with great pomp and circumstance on October 15, 1910. After five years of construction in the heart of downtown San Diego

claims.text: The hotel is recognized as a Gaslamp Quarter historic hotel and preserves its architectural legacy.

findings.quote: Recognized as a Gaslamp Quarter historic hotel, The US Grant preserves its rich architectural legacy

claims.text: The hotel is near Little Italy and the Gaslamp Quarter, at the heart of San Diego's dining, culture and nightlife.

findings.quote: Ideally situated near Little Italy and the Gaslamp Quarter, The US Grant, a Luxury Collection Hotel places guests at the heart of San Diego’s dynamic dining, culture, and nightlife.

claims.text: Nearby attractions include Balboa Park, the San Diego Zoo, Petco Park and the Gaslamp Quarter.

findings.quote: Guests can explore nearby attractions including Balboa Park, the San Diego Zoo, Petco Park, and the vibrant Gaslamp Quarter

claims.text: Rooms showcase evocative art and finishes.

findings.quote: Showcasing evocative art and finishes, our hotel rooms in downtown San Diego offer refined elegance

claims.text: Pillowtop beds feature 350-thread-count sheets and designer duvets.

findings.quote: Sumptuously outfitted, our luxury pillowtop beds feature 350-thread-count sheets and designer duvets

claims.text: Marble bathrooms in select suites feature deep soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Marble bathrooms in select suites feature deep soaking tubs for calming retreats in San Diego

claims.text: Suites include a Presidential Multi-Level Suite with a balcony and living room.

findings.quote: Presidential Multi-Level Suite, 1 Bedroom, 1 King Bed, Balcony, Living Room

claims.text: Grant Grill serves AAA/CAA Four Diamond cuisine in an Art Deco setting, with seasonal dishes from California produce and Pacific seafood.

findings.quote: Enjoy AAA/CAA Four Diamond cuisine in an Art Deco setting, with seasonal dishes from California produce and Pacific seafood

claims.text: Grant Grill has operated since 1951, with mahogany wood, fleur de lis banquettes and white linen-topped tables.

findings.quote: including classic mahogany wood, fleur de lis banquettes, and white linen-topped tables – to the ever-evolving seasonal menus, Grant Grill carries a tradition of excellence since 1951.

claims.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day and is complimentary.

findings.quote: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day
offers a complimentary fitness center to hotel guests during their stay

claims.text: The hotel holds a collection of artworks, including sculptures, ironwork, murals and paintings, by European, American and Native American artists.

findings.quote: including stunning sculptures, ironwork, murals and paintings. Created by carefully selected, world-renowned artists from European, American and Native American backgrounds

claims.text: Every evening at dusk, the concierge team lights candles in the grand lobby, continuing the historic 'keeper of candles' tradition.

findings.quote: the concierge became the “keeper of candles.” Our concierge team continues this historic tradition at our legendary property in our grand lobby every evening at dusk to celebrate the lighting of the candles.

claims.text: The concierge team leads a complimentary tour of the hotel's history and culture for overnight guests, starting Saturdays from the Concierge desk.

findings.quote: Join our expert Concierge team for a tour of The US Grant’s history and culture.
This complimentary tour is available exclusively to our overnight hotel guests and begins every Saturday at 11:00 AM from the Concierge desk.

claims.text: The 11-story historic building has a lobby with chandeliers, glossy tile floors and Corinthian-style columns.

findings.quote: The 11-story historic building is downright regal. Inside, the lobby feels palatial, with sparkling chandeliers, glossy tile floors, and impressive Corinthian-style columns.

claims.text: Many room windows face other rooms, so guests may want to close the blinds for privacy.

findings.quote: Just don't forget to close your blinds for privacy—many of the windows face other rooms.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the premium downtown location is reflected in higher pricing.
